card.title: Apologize to Reality
card.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before your caretaker interview, apologise to that chair. You sat without its consent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell it you're sorry for taking silence as permission.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, chair. I'll stand for the interview.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for making it redundant. You're applying to care for furniture, and your first solution is to leave it without a job.

mechanism: A demands apologies to a chair for contradictory impossible social obligations during a caretaker interview.
confusable: Unlike correcting manners toward people, A must make the object's impossible expectations the offended party.
comparison: B's offer to stand creates alleged redundancy; the doorway scene treats advance phone notice as hurtful priority.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
